Happy Birthday, Aimen Rehman! 💗

May the year ahead bring you peace, success, new adventures, and countless reasons to smile. Never stop shining in your own beautiful way, and may your dreams keep taking you toward wonderful things.

You deserve a day as lovely and special as you are. Keep smiling, keep shining, and make beautiful memories wherever life takes you.

Wishing you the happiest birthday and a year full of magic, laughter, and blessings! 🦋✨

With love,
Muneeb ❤️
